title: sca-v18 Repo Verdict
description: Pareto-frontier multi-dimensional verdict for SOTA-candidate repos. Cite-anchored to DSPy GEPA Pareto-frontier (arxiv 2507.19457), OSSF Criticality Score formula (stars EXCLUDED), inspect_ai EvalLog (UK AISI), Jury-on-Demand K=4 weighted-by-reliability (arxiv 2512.01786), Minority-Veto n>=2 BLOCK override (arxiv 2510.11822, 95.5% TPR + 30.9% TNR vs naive-majority 19.2% TNR), Council-Mode heterogeneity (arxiv 2604.02923), fake-star detection (Kapravelos ICSE-26 + arxiv 2603.10265 MALTA). Replaces sca-v17 binary INSTALL/BLOCK hard-gate with 5-tier soft-gate (W288 §4 lineage). Authored 2026-05-22 from R1 research-architecture-meta-upgrade stream.

license_class.description: permissive=MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC/MPL; source-available=Elastic/BSL/PolyForm; copyleft=AGPL/SSPL; noassertion=no recognized SPDX

maintainership_tier.description: A=corporate-backed AND >=3 named-logo prod users AND <=30d commits; B=corporate/foundation/academic peer-reviewed + active; C=community-maintained <=90d commits; D=academic-only/pre-launch/single-maintainer; F=stale/abandoned

pareto_dominated_by.description: List of other repos that strictly dominate THIS candidate on ALL non-incomparable dimensions. Empty means non-dominated (Pareto-frontier candidate).

convergence.description: Multi-MCP convergence per R1 §4 class-weighted-counting. CLASS-A=raw facts (gh+repomix+codegraph); CLASS-B=LLM web judges (perplexity+exa+firecrawl); CLASS-C=AI-on-repo+academic (deepwiki+hf-papers). 3 LLM-judges parroting same blog != 3 sources.

passes_install_minimum.description: True iff >=1 CLASS-A hit AND >=1 CLASS-C hit. CLASS-B alone is insufficient for INSTALL tier.

ossf_criticality.description: OSSF Criticality Score formula signals + computed score. Stars are NOT in this formula (per primary source).

created_since.description: Months since repo created. weight alpha=1

updated_since.description: Months since last commit. NEGATIVE weight alpha=-1

org_count.description: Number of orgs in top 20 contributors. weight alpha=1

dependents_count.description: Number of dependents on this repo. weight alpha=2

stars_informational.description: Stars carried INFORMATIONAL-ONLY per R1 §5 (anchored 6x: PkgPulse, Kapravelos ICSE-26 fake-stars paper, arxiv 2603.10265 MALTA, beeble.com, dev.to, academic surveys). NEVER weighted into quality score.

star_velocity_30d.description: Stars/day in last 30 days. Drift detector only.

tier.description: Soft-gate ladder per W288 §4 + R1 §3. INSTALL routes UP from PATTERN-STUDY/CITE-ONLY when criteria met; downward routing is automatic on dimension shortfall; BLOCK requires AFFIRMATIVE evidence (license / archived / abandoned).

tier_rationale_per_dim.description: Per-dimension rationale for why this tier was assigned. Pareto-frontier preserved.

confidence.description: TOP-LEVEL/SAFE-DEFAULT confidence (= MIN over confidence_by_dimension axes — surface-this-to-tooling rule per codex r2 G2 MEDIUM 2026-05-22). HIGH requires: passes_install_minimum + no disagreements + jury_verdict APPROVE + replayable eval_log_ref AND ALL confidence_by_dimension axes >= HIGH.

confidence_by_dimension.description: Per-dimension confidence breakdown — Pareto-frontier-aware. Prevents the codex r2 G2 failure mode where scalar HIGH hides integration-risk MEDIUM. Tooling SHOULD surface MIN across axes (= the top-level confidence field) for install-decisions. Each axis confidence orthogonal.

capability.description: Confidence in capability dimension (benchmark + community + paper convergence)

integration_stability.description: Confidence in integration stability (migration-risk, API stability, breaking-change-rate)

license.description: Confidence in license verification (gh-API SPDX + LICENSE-file read)

maintainership.description: Confidence in maintainership signal (corporate-backing + commit cadence + contributor diversity)

production_evidence.description: Confidence in named-logo production deployments (verified-by-independent-source vs vendor-PR)

rationale.description: Free-text rationale for the tier + confidence. Should reference specific dimension scores + convergence sources.

resolution.description: How the disagreement was resolved (e.g., primary-source-verification, codex-mediation).

eval_log_ref.description: Path or URI to the inspect_ai .eval file containing replayable model-pinned + prompt-captured + score-edit-history. Per UK AISI inspect_ai standard. Empty for tier=CITE-ONLY/MONITOR (eval not required).

jury_verdict.description: K=4 weighted-by-per-instance-reliability jury per arxiv 2512.01786. Minority-veto n>=2 BLOCK overrides INSTALL per arxiv 2510.11822 (95.5% TPR + 30.9% TNR empirical). K=2 minimum for INSTALL-tier verdicts (e.g., two distinct codex rounds OR codex+human). codex r4 I1 closure: schema-extended to include structured jurors[] array for audit-trail.

minority_veto_triggered.description: True iff block_count >= 2 (forces tier downgrade from INSTALL to MONITOR/BLOCK regardless of majority)

jurors.description: Structured per-juror audit trail (codex r4 I1 closure). Each entry captures the juror identity + verdict + reference + optional non-juror cross-reference note. Length should match K when juror entries are accumulated; cross-references can be tagged via 'note' field.

ref.description: Path or URL to the juror's review artifact

note.description: Optional: tag this entry as cross-reference (counted) OR adjacent-review (informational, may or may not count toward K).

unique_findings.description: Findings raised by only ONE juror (high-signal even if others missed)

dep_blast_radius_clean.description: Per npm-audit / Socket.dev / Snyk transitive scan

production_users_verified.description: Named-logo production users have INDEPENDENT verification (case study URL, customer page, engineering blog) — NOT vendor-PR alone

migration_notes.description: Migration notes for adopters of this verdict. e.g., if repo moved or rebranded.

follow_up_streams.description: Queued follow-up research streams (per R1 punt-list: R-CALIBRATION, R-TOOLING, R-IMPL, R-STORAGE, R-CODEX, R-COST)
